# PreceptorOS

> PreceptorOS: WEB · APP · LAB — a local-first AI ecosystem. Local memory and
> local inference are the APP's claim (see its README). The WEB makes no external
> request on load, and calls api.preceptoros.org only when a visitor presses send.
> Every figure it publishes was measured; anything not measured is NO_DATA with its cause.

## The ecosystem

- [WEB: preceptoros-web README](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/preceptoros-web/blob/main/README.md): this repository — the public website; its home page is the game theGame, in nine languages. Measured: zero external requests on load.
- [APP: PreceptorOS README](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/PreceptorOS/blob/main/README.md): the local-first companion application — local memory, local inference, zero cloud.
- [STATE.md (APP)](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/PreceptorOS/blob/main/STATE.md): the ecosystem's state card — measured figures with their source, NO_DATA with cause. Written to be read in one pass and handed to another AI.
- [STATE.md (LAB)](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/lab/blob/main/STATE.md): the same state card, published from the measured record.
- [PRECEPTOR.md](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/PreceptorOS/blob/main/PRECEPTOR.md): the contributor contract, signed by the architect. What an AI may do here, and how it must report what it measures.
- [RACK.md](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/PreceptorOS/blob/main/RACK.md): the rack's public card — the machines, what runs on them, what was measured. No addresses, no ports, no keys.

## The measured record

- [LAB benchmarks: bench 2026-10-11 README](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/lab/blob/main/benchmarks/bench_20261011/README.md): embedding and reading benchmarks, measured on the node.
- [LAB benchmarks: raw JSON](https://github.com/piskyRpapalo/lab/blob/main/benchmarks/bench_20261011/bench_20261011_resultados.json): the raw measured results behind the README (sha256 26e61fb7…).

## Live site

- [preceptoros.org](https://preceptoros.org): the served site. Nine languages, zero external requests on load, 75 web tests: 74 passing and 1 skipped (measured; see the LAB counters).
